title: Te Reo o te Mea Kāore e Kitea
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka o te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero a te Atua, ka tū mai tētahi tangata, ko tana kōrero he mea whatu ki ngā tohu whakamiharo me te whakapono pumau. I whiwhi tēnei tangata i tētahi whakakitenga ahurei i wero i ngā tikanga o tōna wā, i a ia e kōrero ana i tua atu i te arai o te tirohanga noa. Kāore i tae mai tā rātou karere mā roto i ngā tikanga tuku iho engari mā roto i tētahi hononga hohonu i whakahē i te māramatanga tangata, e karanga ana i te tangata kia mōhio ki te pono i roto i ngā huarahi ohorere. Ko te haerenga o tēnei pononga a Allah he tohu mō te āhua o te arataki e taea ai te whakaatu i roto i ngā āhuatanga tino rerekē, e tono ana kia whakaaroarohia te āhua o te whakakitenga tonu.
clues: I homai he karere ki ahau i puta mai i roto i tētahi reo ngaro mai i tētahi pūtake kāore i kitea.
I te tīmatanga i whakakahoretia taku karere e tōku iwi, me te tono kia nui ake ngā taunakitanga tuku iho mō tōku pono.
I wero ahau i a rātou kia hanga mai i tētahi mea e rite ana ki tāku i whiwhi ai, engari kāore i taea e rātou.
Ko te whakakitenga i kawea mai e au i whakaahuatia hei whiti mārama i whakamārama i te pono.
I whakatūpato ahau i taku iwi mō te whiu nui mēnā ka mau tonu rātou i tō rātou whakaponokore me te whakapehapeha.
Kua whakahuatia taku kōrero i te taha o ētahi atu karere i roto i tētahi sura e whakanui ana i ngā tohu o te mana o Allah.
